construction: Starting from ODA's R2010 DXF re-exports of the locally generated collision pair, replace the zero-element SAME_KEY and unique MLINESTYLE records with two BYLAYER elements at offsets +0.5 and -0.5 and set end angle to 90 degrees; preserve their distinct start angles and dictionary links. ODA File Converter 27.10.0.0 in an offline linux/amd64 container generated AC1012 DWGs and reopened them to R2010 DXF.
checks: Both files have AC1012 magic; ODA reopened both without a per-file error.
The bounded DXF audit resolves the ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary and selected style owners, names, angles and two-element counts in both ODA exports.
GNU LibreDWG 0.14 independently reads both DWGs and reports the same dictionary owners and selected start angles; every selected style has offsets +0.5 and -0.5 and BYLAYER linetype index 32767.
limits: ODA reopened its own generated files; independent LibreDWG readback is not native AutoCAD acceptance, style validation or duplicate-merge behavior.
The DWGs originate in local explicit-partial DXF projections; no source-completeness claim follows.
Files remain in temporary scratch space and were not committed.
